title: glycosmis longifolia
intro: Glycosmis longifolia, commonly known as Wild Tumeric, is a plant species in the Rutaceae family, native to tropical regions of Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Glycosmis longifolia are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help in soothing skin irritations, wounds, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
